semantic_claims.claim: A change of the active policy never moves a scope that is already frozen; only an explicit, owner-previewed extension of exactly that journal and market-epoch scope raises it.
An extension never resets spend: spend is owned by hfic_ordinary_operation.py and computed from completed looks plus pending reservations, not by the policy module.
A scope with pre-existing history and no snapshot freezes at the shipped defaults (LEGACY_DEFAULTS_V1); read-only paths never write a policy artifact.
No field exceeds its hard fuse via preset, extension or active change; max_diagnostic_slices may only be lowered; present-invalid policy state is a typed refusal, never a silent default.

Bare callers of classify_temporal_look, classify_query_look, decide_preflight_action, epoch_search_budget_usage and resolve_scientific_admission that omit the new kwargs keep shipped behavior; cycle 1 identity/hashes are byte-identical.

The AUTO counter counts real cycles from stored rows; a plain preflight never starts a cycle; cycle 2 needs both an epoch-pool extension and the explicit --additional-cycle and gets its own slot hash and search key (execution identity); the third is denied.

A later AUTO cycle spends its lineage root's MAIN/ADAPTIVE/PREVIEW budget: limits are the root's snapshot plus extensions, spend is the union of completed looks and pending reservations over the lineage journals, an exact saved query is a replay, a new cycle/payload/preset alone never opens fresh budget; the cycle-2 operation must name the accounting root (cycle-1 key before the cycle suffix) and a live parent of the same market, focus and representation (stopped or pending parents are refused, a completed parent may be continued); representations remain their own accounting domains.

The extensions of one apply file commit in a single ResearchStore commit with live parent/pending/scope-head/CAS re-checks under the writer lease: all or nothing, truthful writes, mixed or duplicate-scope sets refused before any write, exact repeat idempotent.
A reserved-but-unlanded PREVIEW is RESUME (spends nothing new, lands the payload on the same reservation), not a completed REPEAT; a pending preview of another operation is not adopted.

A negative terminal (no selected candidate) with more than 6 cards persists, freezes, finalizes and reads back with all identities through additive wide receipt and next-action schemas; historical schemas are unchanged.
Draft packet_version 1.3, receipt v1_4 and the optional receipt cycle_index (integer>=2) are additive; existing packets and receipts validate unchanged.

A value-bearing episode-normalized-view is reserved against the exact operation's PREVIEW budget by request descriptor before any value loads; the identical request spends nothing; metadata-only paths spend nothing.
Policy apply and extension are CAS-protected with idempotent re-apply and bounded WRITER_BUSY retry; a last-slot race has exactly one winner.
